name: chrysaki-comms
description: A pane in the Chrysaki look with the full log of messages between this session and other Claude sessions

maxMessages.title: Messages shown
maxMessages.description: How many of the latest messages the pane draws. The pane says how many earlier messages it leaves out

view.title: Start view
view.description: compact shows one line for each message, with a model summary of a long message. verbose shows the exact words. The v key switches

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model that writes the compact summaries, as an alias or a full id. off sends no message to a model
